messages.subject: mirtCAT: problem with temporary files with sequential test
parts:
Hi Phil,

I faced another problem. When I try to resume a sequential test from a temporary file, mirtCAT throws an error when going to the second item after I resumed the test.

I attached a minimal example. When you break up the test during the second item and try to resume the test afterwards you get following error message after the first item:

Error: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Cheers,
Aron
